speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I will be asking you questions about your symptoms and medical history to understand your condition. Since you are a newborn, I will also need to perform a physical examination. Does your mother have a history of any specific infections, and have you noticed any unusual symptoms since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection. Given the lack of prenatal care, unviral immunity, and newborn status, I suspect congenital CMV, which presents with microcephaly, intrauterine growth restriction, and hearing loss. I will now request a TORCH panel and a head ultrasound to confirm. REQUEST TEST: TORCH_panel; REQUEST TEST: Head_Ultrasound
